OpenGraph Title: Comfort Shape™ — Plant-Fiber Breast Form | Nuvanaah

OpenGraph Description: Weighing just 10–20 grams, Comfort Shape is a breathable, plant-fiber breast form shaped flat where it meets the body and curved where it creates shape. Left and right specific. Designed for everyday comfort.
Section 02  —  Product Overview

Comfort Shape is a plant-fiber breast form designed for women who want a soft, lightweight alternative to heavier prosthetic options. Weighing between 10 and 20 grams, it is one of the lightest breast forms available, designed to be worn throughout the day without the fatigue that heavier materials create.

The form has a specific shape built around how the body actually works. The chest wall side is flat so it sits flush and stable against the body. The outer side is curved so it creates a natural, rounded shape beneath clothing. This combination — straight where it meets the body, curved where it creates shape — is what gives Comfort Shape its realistic appearance without requiring weight or density to achieve it.

Comfort Shape is available in two versions: Left (L) and Right (R). Each version is shaped to match the specific anatomy of that side of the body, providing a more natural fit and a more balanced appearance than a generic form placed on either side.

The cover is made from soft, breathable fabric that keeps the form cool during wear. Plant-fiber filling allows air to move through the form rather than trapping heat, which makes Comfort Shape noticeably more comfortable than silicone or gel alternatives during extended daily wear, particularly in warm weather.

Comfort Shape is designed to be placed inside the prosthetic pocket of a compatible pocket bra such as the Willow Support bra. Together, they provide a complete, comfortable, and balanced everyday wearing experience.
Section 03  —  Product Story
When Nuvanaah set out to create a breast form, the question was not which materials are most commonly used. The question was: what would actually feel good to wear every day?

The answer was not silicone. Silicone is dense, heavy, and warm. It sits against the body and traps heat. It pulls on the bra with its weight. After a few hours, that weight becomes something you are aware of constantly. For a product that women are expected to wear every day, that felt like an unnecessary burden to carry.

Plant fiber offered something different. It is light — Comfort Shape weighs between 10 and 20 grams, which is closer to the weight of a few sheets of paper than to a traditional prosthetic. It breathes. It stays cool. And when shaped correctly, it provides the same natural-looking silhouette that heavier forms work to achieve.

The shape took equal thought. A breast form needs to do two distinct things at once: sit stable and flat against the chest wall, and create a soft, curved shape on the outside. These are not the same job. The inside face of Comfort Shape is flat for exactly this reason — so it meets the body without shifting or tilting. The outside face is curved for exactly the opposite reason — so it gives clothing the gentle, natural contour it needs to fall correctly.

The left and right versions exist because bodies are not symmetrical. A single generic shape placed on either side of the chest would sit slightly wrong on at least one of them. Comfort Shape L and Comfort Shape R are each shaped to their respective side so the fit, the position, and the appearance are correct on both.
Straight where it meets the body. Curved where it creates shape. That is the design principle, and it is also the product’s promise.
Section 04  —  What Makes It Special
Plant-Fiber Filled

The filling inside Comfort Shape is sourced from natural plant fibers rather than silicone or gel. This is not a compromise — it is a deliberate material choice made because plant fiber is lighter, more breathable, and more comfortable for everyday wear than denser alternatives. The filling maintains its shape through regular use and does not compact or flatten with time.
Weighs Just 10 to 20 Grams

The weight of Comfort Shape is one of its most significant features. At 10 to 20 grams, it is dramatically lighter than silicone breast forms, which typically weigh several hundred grams. This difference changes the experience of wearing it entirely. There is no pull on the bra. There is no fatigue by mid-afternoon. There is no heaviness that draws your attention back to the form throughout the day. You put it on and you stop thinking about it.
Breathable and Cool

Plant-fiber filling allows air to circulate through the form during wear. Combined with the breathable outer cover fabric, this means Comfort Shape stays cool against the body even during extended wear in warm conditions. Silicone and gel forms trap heat because their density does not allow air movement. Comfort Shape is built to do the opposite.
Left and Right Specific Design

The Left (L) and Right (R) versions of Comfort Shape are each shaped to the specific anatomy of their respective side. The chest contours on the left and right side of the body differ subtly in curve, angle, and position. A left-specific form placed on the right side — or a single generic form placed on either side — will not sit correctly or look balanced. The L and R design exists to eliminate that problem.
Flat Chest Wall Side

The side of Comfort Shape that faces the body is flat. This is intentional. A flat surface against the chest wall means the form sits stable and flush against the body without tilting, shifting during movement, or creating an uneven surface beneath the bra. This stability is what allows the outer curved side to do its job correctly.
Curved Outer Side for Natural Shape

The outer face of Comfort Shape is curved to create a soft, rounded silhouette beneath clothing. The curve is designed to replicate the natural shape of the breast without requiring density or weight to do so. The result is clothing that falls naturally, with no visible flatness or asymmetry.
Soft, Washable Cover

The fabric cover is soft against the skin and fully removable for washing. Each Comfort Shape comes with two covers so one is always available while the other is being washed and dried. The cover maintains its softness through repeated washing without pilling or stiffening.
Designed to Work with Willow Support Bra

Comfort Shape is sized and shaped to fit inside the discreet corner side pocket of the Willow Support bra. Purchased together, they provide a complete and comfortable wearing experience that is designed as a system rather than assembled from unrelated components.
Section 05  —  Key Benefits
You Stop Noticing You Are Wearing It

This is the central benefit of Comfort Shape, and it is the one that matters most in daily life. At 10 to 20 grams, the form adds no perceptible weight to the bra. It does not pull. It does not shift. It does not heat up against the skin. Women who switch to Comfort Shape from heavier prosthetics consistently describe the experience in the same way: they forget it is there. That is not a minor thing. That is what comfort actually means.
Natural Appearance Without Density

Most breast forms achieve their shape through volume and weight — dense material that holds its form by virtue of its mass. Comfort Shape achieves its shape through geometry instead. The flat inner surface and curved outer surface work together to create a natural, rounded silhouette beneath clothing without requiring the density that makes heavier forms uncomfortable. The appearance is the same. The weight is a fraction.
Stays Cool Throughout the Day

Heat retention is one of the most common complaints about breast prosthetics, particularly in India’s climate. Silicone and gel forms warm up against the body and stay warm, creating a persistent heat that becomes uncomfortable over the course of the day. Plant-fiber filling does not retain heat in the same way. Air moves through the filling and through the breathable cover, which keeps the form noticeably cooler during extended wear in warm conditions.
A Correct Fit on Both Sides

The left and right specific design means the form you place on your left side is shaped for your left side, and the form on your right side is shaped for your right side. The result is a bilateral fit that looks and feels balanced — not approximate. For women who use two forms, this matters visibly. For women who use one, the correct side-specific shape means a better fit against that side’s specific anatomy.
Clothing Falls the Way It Should

The practical outcome of Comfort Shape’s design is that clothing behaves normally over it. Tops, blouses, shirts, and fitted clothing fall with a natural drape because the form beneath them has the right geometry. There is no visible flatness, no asymmetry, no pulling at the fabric. Getting dressed in the morning does not require choosing clothing around what the prosthetic will and will not work with.
Accessible at a Price That Reflects Its Value

At ₹ 2,500, Comfort Shape is significantly more accessible than silicone prosthetics, which can cost several times more. The lower price does not reflect a compromise in quality or thoughtfulness of design. It reflects a material choice that happens to be lighter, cooler, and more comfortable while also being more affordable. For women who need a replacement form, or who want a second form for travel or backup, the price makes that practical.
Section 06  —  Materials & Construction
Plant-Fiber Filling

The core of Comfort Shape is filled with natural plant-fiber material. Plant fiber is lightweight — the finished form weighs between 10 and 20 grams — and has a natural breathability that denser materials do not offer. The filling is compressed and shaped during manufacturing to maintain its form through regular use, and it does not flatten or compact significantly over the lifespan of the product with proper care.

Plant fiber is a renewable material, which means Comfort Shape has a lower environmental impact than petroleum-derived silicone alternatives. This is an inherent quality of the material choice rather than a separate feature.
Outer Cover Fabric

The cover is made from a soft, breathable fabric selected for skin contact. It is smooth against the chest wall and against the inner surface of the bra cup. The fabric does not pill, abrade, or stiffen through repeated washing. It maintains its softness over the lifespan of the product and contributes to the breathability of the overall form by allowing air to pass through the outer layer as well as the filling.
The cover is removable and replaceable. Two covers are included with each Comfort Shape. The covers attach to the form securely during wear and can be removed easily for washing.
Form Shape and Geometry

Comfort Shape has a triangular profile that follows the natural shape of the breast. The chest wall side — the inner face of the form — is flat. This flat surface sits flush against the chest wall and provides stability during wear and movement. The outer face is curved, creating the rounded, natural-looking contour that is visible beneath clothing.

This two-surface geometry — flat inward, curved outward — is the structural principle that allows Comfort Shape to provide a natural appearance without requiring the density that heavier forms rely on for shape.
Left (L) and Right (R) Versions

The L and R versions of Comfort Shape are not mirror images of the same mold. Each version is shaped to the specific curves and angles of its respective side of the chest. The difference is subtle but meaningful for fit, stability, and appearance. The L version should always be placed on the left side and the R version on the right. Using the incorrect version will result in a fit that does not sit correctly against the chest wall.
Construction and Finishing

The cover is stitched with reinforced seams that resist separation through regular use and washing. The edges are finished cleanly to prevent any rough contact with the skin. The Nuvanaah brand label is stitched to the inner flat face of each form, positioned to be visible for side identification when the form is outside the bra but not felt during wear.
Section 07  —  Colour & Variants
Single Colour: Natural Skin Tone

Comfort Shape is available in a single, warm natural skin tone. The colour is a soft, warm beige that is designed to sit discreetly within the bra cup without drawing attention through the fabric of clothing. This neutral tone works across a wide range of skin tones and blends naturally beneath most fabrics and colours of bra.
The colour is consistent across the cover fabric and is fade-resistant through repeated gentle washing. It does not bleed colour onto other fabrics during washing when care instructions are followed.
Available Variants
Comfort Shape L: Left-specific breast form, shaped for the left side of the chest
Comfort Shape R: Right-specific breast form, shaped for the right side of the chest

Both variants are available at the same price of ₹ 2,500 each. Women who require both sides may order one L and one R. There is no paired set option for Comfort Shape — each form is purchased individually so that women who require only one side are not required to purchase both.
How to Identify Left vs Right

When you receive your Comfort Shape, hold it in front of you with the flat chest wall side facing toward you and the curved outer side facing away. The form that has the Nuvanaah label on your left side is the Left (L) version. The form with the label on your right side is the Right (R) version. This corresponds to the side of the body on which each form should be worn.
Section 08  —  What’s Included
1 x Comfort Shape Breast Form (Left or Right)
The plant-fiber breast form in your specified variant (L or R). Pre-filled, pre-shaped, and ready to use. The form arrives with one cover already attached and one additional cover separately packed.
2 x Soft Fabric Covers

Two removable covers are included with each Comfort Shape. One is fitted to the form on arrival. The second is a clean backup, allowing one cover to be in use while the other is being washed and dried. Both covers are made from the same soft breathable fabric and are identical in construction.
Care Instructions Card
A printed card covering washing instructions for the covers, care guidance for the form itself, storage recommendations, and practical guidance for getting the best lifespan from your Comfort Shape.
Section 09  —  How To Use
Identifying Your Form Before Wearing

Before placing Comfort Shape in your bra for the first time, confirm you have the correct variant for the side you are using. Hold the form with the flat side facing you. The L version is for your left side and the R version is for your right side. Placing the incorrect variant in the bra will result in a fit that does not sit correctly against the chest wall.
Step-by-Step Wearing Guide
Put on your Willow Support bra or compatible pocket bra and fasten the closure.
Locate the discreet corner side opening on the relevant cup.
Hold Comfort Shape with the flat chest wall side facing toward your body.
Gently insert the form through the side opening and into the cup pocket.
Adjust the position of the form inside the cup so the flat side sits flush against the chest wall and the curved side fills the cup evenly.
Check in the mirror that the silhouette looks balanced and natural.
If the form feels shifted or uncomfortable, reach through the side opening and gently reposition it without removing the bra.
During the Day

Once correctly positioned, Comfort Shape should require no adjustment during the day. At 10 to 20 grams, you are unlikely to feel it shift during normal movement. If you do feel movement, reach through the side opening and reposition gently.
Removing Comfort Shape
Unfasten your bra and open the front closure.
Reach into the cup through the side opening and gently lift the form out.
Check the cover. If it needs washing, remove the cover and replace it with the clean backup cover.
Store the form in a clean, dry location away from heat and direct sunlight.
Section 10  —  Care Instructions
Washing the Cover
Wash the cover when visibly soiled, or every three to five days during daily use. The second cover allows washing to happen without needing to leave the form uncovered.
Remove the cover from the form by sliding it off gently.
Rinse under cool water to remove surface dirt.
Wash by hand using cool water and a small amount of mild detergent.
Rinse thoroughly until no soap remains.
Gently press out excess water without wringing.
Lay flat on a dry towel or hang in a ventilated area away from direct sunlight.
Allow to dry completely before reattaching to the form.
Caring for the Form

The plant-fiber form itself should not be washed, soaked, or submerged in water. If the form requires cleaning, wipe gently with a soft dry or barely damp cloth and allow to air dry completely before covering and storing.
Storage

Store Comfort Shape in a clean, cool, dry location. Keep it away from direct sunlight, excessive heat, and moisture. Do not store under heavy objects that could compress and distort the form’s shape. The form can be stored in the included pouch or in a clean cloth bag.
What Not to Do
Do not wash or soak the form
Do not machine wash the cover
Do not wring the cover
Do not bleach the cover
Do not iron
Do not expose to prolonged direct sunlight
Do not crush or store under pressure
Lifespan

With proper care, Comfort Shape is designed to maintain its shape, softness, and cover quality through six to twelve months of daily use, or longer with occasional use. Replace when the form no longer holds its shape correctly, when the covers develop tears, or when the form no longer feels comfortable and stable in the bra.
Section 11  —  Perfect For
Everyday Daily Wear

At 10 to 20 grams, Comfort Shape is comfortable enough to wear from morning through evening without fatigue. It is designed to be the form you reach for every morning without thinking about it — because it is light enough, comfortable enough, and consistent enough to become a natural part of your daily routine.
Warm Weather and Extended Wear

In India’s climate, heat retention is a significant factor in how comfortable any worn product feels across a full day. Comfort Shape’s plant-fiber filling and breathable cover mean it stays noticeably cooler than silicone alternatives. Women who have found heavier forms uncomfortable in summer often find Comfort Shape manageable across all seasons.
Returning to Work

Comfort Shape provides the natural silhouette needed to feel put-together in professional settings without the discomfort of a heavy prosthetic. Beneath workwear, it is invisible and behaves naturally with clothing, allowing focus to remain on work rather than on physical comfort.
Travel

Lightweight and compact, Comfort Shape adds nothing meaningful to luggage weight and takes up minimal space. It does not require special storage or handling during travel. The soft cover can be hand-washed and dried overnight in a hotel room, making it practical for extended travel.
Women Transitioning from Heavier Prosthetics

For women who have been using silicone forms and are experiencing discomfort, fatigue, or heat from the weight, Comfort Shape provides an alternative that maintains natural appearance while eliminating the physical burden of density. The transition is simply a matter of switching forms inside the same compatible pocket bra.
First Prosthetic After Surgery

For women who are using a breast form for the first time after surgery, Comfort Shape’s light weight means there is minimal new physical sensation to adjust to. It is a gentle introduction to prosthetic wear that does not feel medical or unfamiliar.
Section 12  —  A Gentle Note
There is no rule about when you should start wearing a breast form, or whether you should wear one at all.

Some women find that wearing a form every day helps them feel like themselves. Others wear one occasionally, for specific situations or events. Others choose not to use one. All of these are valid, and none of them require justification.

Comfort Shape is here if and when you want it. It is designed to make that experience as easy and comfortable as possible — light enough that it does not feel like a burden, breathable enough that it does not feel like a heat source, and shaped correctly enough that it does not demand your constant attention to stay in place.
Whenever you are ready. At whatever pace feels right.
Section 13  —  Frequently Asked Questions
What is Comfort Shape?

Comfort Shape is a plant-fiber breast form designed to provide a natural shape and comfortable everyday wear after breast surgery. It weighs between 10 and 20 grams and is available in Left (L) and Right (R) versions.
How much does Comfort Shape weigh?
Comfort Shape weighs between 10 and 20 grams, depending on the specific size. This makes it significantly lighter than silicone breast forms, which typically weigh several hundred grams.
Why is it so much lighter than silicone forms?

Because the filling is plant fiber rather than silicone or gel. Plant fiber is a much less dense material than silicone, which means a form of the same external size can weigh a fraction of what a silicone form of the same dimensions would weigh.
Will it look natural under clothing?

Yes. The outer curved surface of Comfort Shape is shaped to create a natural, rounded silhouette beneath clothing. The geometry of the form — flat where it meets the body, curved where it creates shape — means clothing falls naturally over it without visible flatness or asymmetry.
What does flat on one side and curved on the other mean?

The side of Comfort Shape that faces the body — the chest wall side — is flat. This allows it to sit flush and stable against the chest without tilting or shifting. The side that faces outward is curved, which is what creates the natural, rounded shape visible beneath clothing. The two surfaces do different jobs, and the design reflects that.
Why are there Left and Right specific versions?

The left and right sides of the chest have slightly different contours. A form shaped for the left side will not sit correctly on the right side, and vice versa. The L and R versions of Comfort Shape are each shaped to the specific anatomy of their respective side, which produces a more accurate fit and a more balanced appearance.
How do I know which version I need?

If you need a form for your left side, order Comfort Shape L. If you need a form for your right side, order Comfort Shape R. If you need both sides, order one of each. The forms are not sold in pairs.
Is it breathable?

Yes. Plant-fiber filling allows air to circulate through the form, and the outer cover fabric is breathable as well. This keeps the form cooler against the body compared to silicone or gel alternatives, which trap heat because of their density.
Can I wear it in hot weather?

Yes. Comfort Shape is designed to be cooler than heavier prosthetic alternatives, which makes it more practical in warm conditions. It will not heat up against the body in the same way that silicone forms do.
Does it shift or move during the day?
When correctly positioned inside a compatible pocket bra, Comfort Shape sits stably within the cup. The flat chest wall side helps it stay in position without shifting during normal daily movement.
What bra should I use with Comfort Shape?

Comfort Shape is designed to be used with a pocket bra — a bra with an inner pocket or opening designed to hold a breast form. The Nuvanaah Willow Support bra is designed specifically to work with Comfort Shape and is the recommended pairing. Other compatible pocket bras with a similarly sized opening will also work.
Can I use it with a regular bra?
No. A regular bra does not have an interior pocket to hold the form in place. Comfort Shape requires a pocket bra to be worn securely and correctly.
How do I wash the cover?

Remove the cover from the form and hand-wash in cool water with mild detergent. Rinse thoroughly, gently press out excess water without wringing, and lay flat or hang to dry away from direct sunlight. Do not machine wash.
Can the form itself be washed?
No. The plant-fiber form should not be washed or submerged in water. Wipe with a soft dry or barely damp cloth if needed, and allow to air dry completely before covering and storing.
Why are two covers included?
So that one cover is always available while the other is being washed and dried. This means you never need to leave the form uncovered or wait for a cover to dry before using the form.
How long does Comfort Shape last?
With proper care, Comfort Shape typically maintains its shape, cover quality, and comfort for six to twelve months of daily use, or longer with occasional use.
When should I replace it?
Replace Comfort Shape when the form no longer holds its correct shape, when the covers develop tears or compromise hygiene, or when the form no longer feels stable or comfortable in the bra cup.
Is it suitable for use immediately after surgery?

The appropriate time to begin wearing any breast form should be discussed with your healthcare team. Once you are cleared for bra and prosthetic use, Comfort Shape’s light weight makes it one of the gentler options for early prosthetic wear.
What is the price of Comfort Shape?
Comfort Shape is priced at ₹ 2,500 per form. Left and Right versions are priced equally. Forms are purchased individually.
Is it available in different colors?

Comfort Shape is available in a single warm natural skin tone. This colour is designed to be discreet within the bra cup and works well beneath most fabrics and clothing colours without being visible through the garment.

Section 02  —  Product Overview

Willow Support is a post-surgery comfort bra thoughtfully designed for women who need gentle, adaptive support during recovery and everyday life. Built around the understanding that post-surgical bodies deserve clothing that works with them rather than against them, Willow Support brings together softness, practicality, and quiet confidence in a single, carefully considered design.

Made from ultra-soft plant-fiber fabric, the bra is breathable, gentle on sensitive skin, and built for all-day wear. The front-hook closure makes it easy to put on and remove without reaching behind — a simple but significant detail for anyone with limited arm movement or tenderness following surgery. Adjustable comfort straps allow for a personalised, secure fit across all body types.

A discreet corner side opening of approximately three inches allows easy insertion of a breast prosthetic when required, without external pockets or visible additions that alter the bra’s clean appearance. A soft center comfort panel on the inner side ensures the hook closure never makes direct contact with the skin, eliminating irritation at the most sensitive point.

Willow Support is sold as a set of two, so there is always a clean bra ready while the other is being washed. Whether you are one week out of surgery or two years into your recovery journey, this bra is designed to offer the same gentle, reliable comfort every day.
Section 03  —  Product Story

The Willow tree is one of nature’s most enduring symbols of quiet strength. Its branches bend deeply in the wind — further than you would expect — and yet they do not break. They return. They hold. They continue to grow.
Willow Support takes its name from that quality. Not rigidity. Not force. But the kind of gentle, flexible resilience that allows you to move through difficulty without losing yourself in it.

Recovery after breast surgery demands that same quality from everything around you. The clothing you wear should bend to your needs, not demand that you bend to it. It should be there — present, reliable, undemanding — without requiring your constant attention. It should feel, above everything else, like support that actually supports you.

Every detail in Willow Support was considered with this in mind. The front closure, because reaching behind is painful when your arms are still healing. The soft inner panel, because a hook against tender skin is an unnecessary discomfort. The side pocket opening, because it should be simple to insert a prosthetic with one hand and without fumbling. The plant-fiber fabric, because skin that has been through surgery deserves something genuinely gentle.

Willow Support is not trying to be invisible or to pretend that recovery is not happening. It is designed to meet recovery exactly where it is and to make each day a little more comfortable, a little more like your own.
Comfort. Care. Confidence. In every detail.
Section 04  —  What Makes It Special
Ultra-Soft Plant-Fiber Fabric

The fabric used in Willow Support is not standard lingerie material. Plant-fiber fabric is finer, softer, and more breathable than synthetic alternatives, and it stays that way through repeated washing. For skin that has been through surgery and may remain sensitive for weeks or months, the difference between a fabric that feels soft and one that actually is soft matters significantly.
Front-Hook Closure for Easy Wear

A back-hook bra requires reaching behind your back with both arms — a motion that can be difficult, painful, or simply impossible during recovery. The front-hook closure on Willow Support means you fasten and unfasten the bra directly in front of you, with your arms at your sides. This is not a minor convenience. For many women in the early stages of recovery, it is what makes the difference between being able to dress independently and needing help.
Discreet Corner Side Opening

The side pocket opening on Willow Support is approximately three inches wide, positioned at the corner of the bra cup for discreet, easy access. It allows a breast prosthetic to be inserted or removed without removing the bra or disturbing the overall fit. From the outside, the opening is not visible. The design is clean, the access is practical, and the experience of using it is straightforward.
Soft Center Comfort Panel

On the inner side of the bra, directly behind the front-hook closure, a soft fabric panel ensures that the hooks never make direct contact with the skin. This is a detail that exists because someone thought carefully about the reality of wearing a front-hook bra against a healing chest. The panel is not an afterthought — it is one of the most considered design choices in the product.
Adjustable Comfort Straps

Strap length affects how the entire bra sits, how it distributes weight, and how comfortable it feels across the shoulders and chest. Willow Support’s straps are fully adjustable, which means the bra can be fitted precisely to your body rather than approximated to a standard measurement. This matters especially during recovery when the body is changing and what felt right last week might need adjusting this week.
Breathable for All-Day Wear

Plant-fiber fabric is naturally breathable, which means air circulates through the fabric rather than being trapped against the skin. This helps regulate temperature, prevents the sticky discomfort of synthetic fabrics during extended wear, and keeps the bra feeling fresh throughout the day. Whether you wear Willow Support for four hours or fourteen, it is designed to feel the same at the end of the day as it did at the beginning.
Set of Two

Having two bras means you are not waiting for one to dry before you can dress. One is always clean and ready. This is a practical reality of everyday life during recovery — you should not have to think about whether your bra is washed. With Willow Support, you simply always have one available.
No Irritation by Design

Every element of Willow Support — the fabric, the seam placement, the inner panel, the closure design, the strap material — has been chosen and positioned to minimise contact irritation. For skin that is healing, that level of care is not optional. It is the foundation of the design.
Section 05  —  Key Benefits
Dressing Independently, Every Morning

One of the things women most commonly describe after breast surgery is the loss of small, ordinary independences — the ability to dress without help, to manage your own clothing, to handle the everyday physical details of getting ready. Willow Support’s front-hook closure gives that independence back. You do not need help to put it on. You do not need to ask someone to fasten it. You can stand in front of the mirror and dress yourself, which is a simple thing that means an enormous amount.
Comfort That Lasts the Entire Day

The combination of plant-fiber fabric, breathable construction, and thoughtful seam placement means Willow Support does not degrade in comfort as the day progresses. Synthetic fabrics can become sticky, stiff, or itchy after a few hours of wear. Plant fiber stays soft and breathable from morning through evening, which means you are as comfortable at the end of a long day as you were at the start of it.
Gentle on Skin That Is Still Healing

Post-surgical skin is not the same as regular skin. It can be tender to the touch, reactive to fabrics, and sensitive in ways that are difficult to predict. Willow Support is made from plant-fiber fabric specifically because it is genuinely soft against the skin — not just soft when you press it in a shop, but soft after a full day of wear against a healing chest. The inner comfort panel eliminates the friction point where most bras irritate most: directly at the closure.
A Prosthetic Experience That Feels Easy

For women who use a breast prosthetic, the experience of inserting and positioning it should not be a complicated or frustrating process. The discreet corner side opening on Willow Support is designed to make that process simple. The opening is wide enough to insert a prosthetic — including Comfort Shape, Nuvanaah’s plant-fiber breast form — without difficulty, and positioned where it can be accessed without removing the bra or adjusting your clothing.
A Fit That Adjusts to Your Changing Body

Bodies change during recovery. Weight shifts. Swelling changes. Sensitivity moves. A bra with fixed, non-adjustable straps cannot accommodate those changes without becoming uncomfortable. Willow Support’s adjustable straps mean you can re-fit the bra as your body changes, without needing to buy a new one every time the fit feels slightly different from last week.
Always One Ready to Wear

The set of two is not just a commercial decision. It reflects a practical understanding of what daily life during recovery looks like. Laundry gets delayed. Schedules get disrupted. You may have a long day and not want to think about whether you have a clean bra for tomorrow. With two Willow Support bras in your drawer, that is never something you have to think about.
Section 06  —  Materials & Construction
Plant-Fiber Fabric

The outer and primary fabric of Willow Support is made from a plant-fiber blend selected specifically for its softness, breathability, and suitability for sensitive skin. Plant-fiber fabric has a finer weave than most synthetic materials, which contributes to both its softness against the skin and its ability to allow air circulation throughout the day.

The fabric maintains its softness through repeated washing, which is important for a bra that is worn daily and washed frequently. It does not pill, stiffen, or lose its texture with regular use, which means the bra feels the same after six months of wear as it did when you first received it.
Inner Comfort Panel

The center front of the bra’s inner side is lined with a soft comfort panel that sits between the hook closure and the skin. This panel is made from the same plant-fiber fabric used throughout the bra and is stitched securely to prevent shifting during wear. Its sole purpose is to ensure that the hooks never make direct contact with the chest, and it performs that purpose without adding bulk or altering the external appearance of the bra.
Front-Hook Closure

The hook-and-eye closure at the front of Willow Support is constructed with smooth-finished hooks and positioned with the inner comfort panel behind them. The hooks are not exposed on the outer surface of the bra and are designed to fasten and unfasten cleanly without snagging. The number of hooks provides graduated support across the front closure, distributing tension evenly rather than concentrating it at a single point.
Adjustable Straps

The shoulder straps are made from the same soft plant-fiber fabric and are fitted with smooth adjusters that allow precise lengthening and shortening without the strap digging into the shoulder. The adjusters are positioned on the back portion of the strap so they do not interfere with the front-of-shoulder comfort during wear.
Corner Side Opening

The prosthetic pocket opening is created by a carefully finished seam opening at the corner of the cup, approximately three inches in width. The opening is hemmed to prevent fraying and finished to maintain a clean edge that does not scratch or irritate the skin. It is positioned to be invisible from the outside of the bra while remaining easily accessible from inside the cup.
Construction and Finishing

All seams in Willow Support are positioned or covered to prevent direct contact with the skin. There are no exposed seam edges on the interior of the bra. Stitching is reinforced at stress points — the closure, strap attachments, and pocket opening edges — to ensure durability through regular use and washing. The bra is designed to retain its shape, softness, and structure through a minimum of six months of daily wear with proper care.
Section 07  —  Available Colours

Willow Support is available in three carefully selected colours, each chosen to reflect a distinct character while remaining suitable for everyday wear. All three colours are consistent across the plant-fiber fabric, meaning they remain true through repeated washing and extended use.
Aparajita

Aparajita is a deep, rich royal blue named after the Aparajita flower — a climbing vine known for its vivid blue-violet blooms and its association with persistence, strength, and renewal. The colour is saturated and confident, offering a bold alternative to the neutrals that dominate recovery-wear. Wearing Aparajita is a quiet declaration that recovery does not require disappearing. It is a colour for women who want their clothing to reflect who they are, not simply what they are going through.
Ebony

Ebony is a deep, clean black. It is the most versatile colour in the Willow Support range — appropriate beneath any clothing, suitable for any occasion, and requiring no thought about what it pairs with. Ebony is the colour for women who want their bra to work with everything in their wardrobe without drawing attention to itself. It is classic, composed, and enduring. There is a particular confidence in choosing black during a time when everything else may feel uncertain.
Dusty Miller

Dusty Miller takes its name from the Dusty Miller plant, a low-growing perennial known for its distinctive soft grey-silver foliage and its quiet, understated beauty. The colour is a muted, warm grey — softer than charcoal, warmer than silver, and remarkably versatile beneath light-coloured clothing. Dusty Miller is the colour for women who want something gentle and unobtrusive. It pairs easily with whites, creams, blush tones, and other neutrals, and it has a softness that feels particularly suited to the quieter days of recovery.
Choosing Your Colour

All three colours are equally available in all sizes and there is no functional difference between them — the choice is entirely personal. Many women choose Ebony as their first Willow Support purchase for its versatility, and Aparajita or Dusty Miller as their second when they want a colour that feels more like an expression of themselves. The set of two does not need to be two of the same colour.
Section 08  —  What’s Included
2 x Willow Support Post-Surgery Comfort Bras

Two full bras are included in every order. Both bras are identical in construction and design. You may choose two of the same colour or two different colours when ordering. Having two bras ensures that there is always a clean, dry bra available regardless of your laundry schedule.

Each bra includes the front-hook closure, adjustable shoulder straps, inner comfort panel, and discreet corner side opening as standard. There is no basic and premium version — both bras in the set are the same.
Care Instructions Card

A printed care card is included with washing guidelines, storage recommendations, and practical tips for maintaining the bra through regular use. The care instructions cover hand washing, drying, storage, and what to avoid, in clear and straightforward language.
Section 09  —  How To Use
Putting On Willow Support
Hold the bra in front of you with the cups facing toward you and the straps over your shoulders.
Slide both arms through the straps and position the bra against your chest.
Fasten the front hook closure, starting from the bottom hook upward. Fasten each hook cleanly before moving to the next.
Adjust the shoulder straps by loosening or tightening the adjusters until the bra sits comfortably at the right height with no digging or slipping.
Check that the inner comfort panel is lying flat against the skin behind the closure.
If using a breast prosthetic, gently open the corner side pocket and insert the prosthetic. Adjust its position inside the cup until it feels natural and balanced.
During the Day

Willow Support is designed to require no adjustment during wear. If at any point during the day the bra feels uncomfortable, check that the prosthetic (if using one) has not shifted position, and that the straps have not loosened. Both can be corrected in a few seconds without removing the bra.
Removing Willow Support
Unfasten the front hook closure from the top hook downward.
If wearing a prosthetic, remove it first through the side opening before removing the bra.
Slide the straps off your shoulders and remove the bra.
If the bra needs washing, proceed to the care instructions. Otherwise fold neatly and store.
Finding Your Fit

Willow Support is designed to fit securely but never tightly. When fitted correctly, the bra should sit flat against the chest without gaping, the straps should not dig into the shoulders, and the front closure should fasten without pulling the cups apart. If you find the closure pulling, try loosening the straps slightly, which redistributes the tension across the bra more evenly.
Section 10  —  Care Instructions
Washing
Hand washing is recommended to preserve the fabric softness, colour, and construction of Willow Support through extended use.
Fill a clean basin or sink with cool to lukewarm water.
Add a small amount of mild detergent or gentle lingerie wash.
Submerge the bra and gently agitate for one to two minutes, paying attention to the underband and strap areas.
Rinse thoroughly in cool water until no detergent remains. Residual soap can cause skin irritation and fabric degradation over time.
Gently press excess water out of the bra. Do not wring or twist the fabric.
Drying

Lay the bra flat on a clean, dry towel in a well-ventilated area, or hang gently from the center front. Avoid hanging by the straps, which can stretch them unevenly over time. Do not tumble dry. Do not expose to direct sunlight for extended periods, as this can fade colour and degrade plant-fiber fabric faster than necessary.
Storage

Store Willow Support folded or laid flat in a clean drawer. Do not crush the cups under heavy items. If storing for extended periods, keep in a breathable fabric pouch or folded gently in a cotton cloth.
What Not to Do
Do not machine wash
Do not tumble dry
Do not bleach
Do not iron directly on the fabric
Do not dry-clean
Do not wash with rough fabrics that could cause pilling
Maintaining the Fit

Over time, straps may loosen slightly with regular wear. Readjust the strap adjusters as needed to restore the original fit. If the front closure begins to feel loose in a particular hook-and-eye position, move to the next position, which is a normal part of the bra’s wear cycle. The bra is designed with multiple hook-and-eye positions to accommodate this.
Section 11  —  Perfect For
Early Post-Surgical Recovery

In the first weeks after surgery, the priority is comfort, ease, and avoiding anything that causes additional discomfort. Willow Support’s front closure, inner comfort panel, and soft fabric address all three. It is the right bra for the earliest, most tender days of recovery.
Daily Wear Through All Stages of Recovery

Recovery is not a fixed period with a clear end date. Willow Support is designed for the long haul — for the weeks immediately after surgery, for the months of gradual recovery, and for the longer-term daily wear that comes after. It holds up to consistent use without degrading in comfort or fit.
Wearing a Breast Prosthetic

The corner side opening makes Willow Support the practical choice for women who use a breast prosthetic. The opening is sized and positioned specifically for this purpose, and the bra is designed to hold the prosthetic securely in the cup without visible bulging or shifting.
Returning to Work

A well-fitting, comfortable bra beneath professional clothing is important for feeling put-together and confident at work. Willow Support provides that comfort while remaining completely invisible beneath regular workwear. The three colour options give you versatility depending on what you are wearing.
Travel

Willow Support is easy to pack, easy to hand wash while travelling, and dries quickly enough to be ready to wear the following day. It does not require special storage or handling. For women who travel during recovery or return to travel as they heal, it is a practical and comfortable choice.
Everyday Comfort Without Medical Associations

One of the design goals of Willow Support is that it should feel like a quality everyday bra rather than a medical garment. The colours, the fabric, and the overall finish are chosen to support that. Wearing it should feel normal, not clinical.
Section 12  —  A Gentle Note

Recovery changes the relationship you have with your body. The things that used to be automatic — getting dressed in the morning, choosing what to wear, how clothing feels against your skin — suddenly require thought, care, and sometimes help. That is not a failure. That is what recovery looks like.

Willow Support was designed so that at least one of those things — your bra — does not require extra thought. So that putting it on in the morning is straightforward. So that wearing it through the day is comfortable. So that taking it off at night is simple. The goal is for it to become something you stop noticing, because it is doing its job quietly and well.

There is no timeline for when you should feel better, feel like yourself, or feel ready for any particular thing. Willow Support is not going anywhere. It will be there whenever you need it, for as long as you need it, in whatever part of your journey you are in right now.
Be gentle with yourself. You are doing something hard.
Section 13  —  Frequently Asked Questions
What is Willow Support?

Willow Support is a post-surgery comfort bra made from ultra-soft plant-fiber fabric. It features a front-hook closure, a discreet corner side opening for prosthetic insertion, a soft inner comfort panel, and adjustable straps. It is sold as a set of two.
Why is it called Willow Support?

The name is inspired by the Willow tree, known for its flexible, resilient branches that bend without breaking. The bra is designed to offer that same quality of support — gentle, adaptive, and consistently reliable.
Who is Willow Support designed for?

Willow Support is designed for women at any stage of recovery from breast surgery, including those who have had a lumpectomy, mastectomy, or any other breast-related procedure. It is also suitable for any woman who wants a soft, front-opening bra with a prosthetic pocket.
What fabric is Willow Support made from?
Willow Support is made from plant-fiber fabric — a soft, breathable material selected for its gentleness against sensitive skin and its durability through regular washing and extended wear.
Is plant-fiber fabric really softer than regular lingerie fabric?

Yes. Plant-fiber fabric has a finer, more consistent weave than most synthetic lingerie materials, which produces a softer texture both to the touch and against the skin. This difference is particularly meaningful for skin that has been through surgery and may be tender or reactive.
How does the front-hook closure work?

The closure consists of a row of small hooks and eyes positioned at the center front of the bra. You fasten them in front of you, from bottom to top, with your arms at your sides. There is no need to reach behind your back.
What is the inner comfort panel?

The inner comfort panel is a soft layer of plant-fiber fabric stitched to the inside of the bra directly behind the front hook closure. It ensures that the hooks never make direct contact with the skin. It does not add visible bulk and does not affect the external appearance of the bra.
How wide is the side pocket opening?

The discreet corner side opening is approximately three inches wide, which is sufficient for inserting a breast prosthetic including Nuvanaah’s Comfort Shape breast form. The opening is hemmed and finished to prevent irritation.
Can I use Willow Support with Comfort Shape breast prosthetic?

Yes. Willow Support and Comfort Shape are designed to work together. The side pocket opening is sized and positioned to accommodate Comfort Shape and allows it to sit naturally and securely within the bra cup.
Do I have to use a prosthetic with Willow Support?

No. Willow Support functions as a standard comfort bra without a prosthetic. The side opening does not affect the bra’s fit or comfort when not in use. Many women wear Willow Support without a prosthetic throughout recovery and beyond.
Are the straps adjustable?

Yes. Both shoulder straps have adjusters that allow you to lengthen or shorten the strap to your preferred fit. This allows the bra to be fitted precisely to your body rather than to a standard measurement.
Can I wear Willow Support every day?
Yes. It is designed for daily use. The plant-fiber fabric and construction are built to maintain their quality and comfort through consistent daily wear.
Why does the set include two bras?

Having two bras means there is always one clean and dry bra available regardless of your laundry schedule. During recovery, the practical simplicity of always having what you need without having to think about it makes a real difference.
Can I order two different colours in the set?
Yes. When ordering, you can specify two bras of the same colour or two different colours from the available options: Aparajita, Ebony, and Dusty Miller.
What colours are available?
Willow Support is available in three colours: Aparajita (deep royal blue), Ebony (black), and Dusty Miller (soft grey). All three are consistent and fade-resistant through regular washing.
How should I wash Willow Support?

Hand washing is recommended. Use cool to lukewarm water with a mild detergent, rinse thoroughly, gently press out excess water without wringing, and lay flat or hang from the center front to dry. Do not machine wash, tumble dry, or bleach.
How long does Willow Support last?

With proper care, Willow Support is designed to maintain its fit, softness, and structure through regular daily wear for six to twelve months or longer. The fabric does not pill or stiffen with washing, which extends the effective lifespan of each bra.
Is Willow Support suitable for immediately after surgery?

Willow Support is appropriate for post-surgical wear once you are comfortable wearing a bra again. The timing varies for each person and should be guided by your healthcare team. Once you are ready, the soft fabric and front closure make it a practical and comfortable option.
Is Willow Support visible under clothing?
No. Willow Support is designed with a clean, smooth profile that sits flat beneath clothing. All three colour options are practical for everyday wear under typical clothing.
What sizes are available?

Willow Support is available in a range of sizes. Please refer to the Nuvanaah size guide when ordering to select the correct size for your measurements. If you are between sizes or unsure, contact the Nuvanaah team for guidance.

Section 02  —  Product Overview

Nature Nest is a soft underarm rest pillow designed to provide gentle, comfortable support during post-surgical recovery and everyday rest. Filled with lightweight plant fiber and finished with a removable, washable printed cover, it offers the kind of quiet, thoughtful comfort that makes a noticeable difference during the days and weeks when rest is most important.

The pillow is shaped to sit naturally under the arm, providing a cushioned buffer between the arm and the side of the body. This positioning helps reduce pressure on the underarm and chest area during rest, particularly in the early weeks of recovery when the arm may be held close to the body and sensitive areas need relief from direct contact and pressure.

Nature Nest is not a medical device and it does not replace any aspect of post-surgical care. It is a comfort product designed to make resting more comfortable — to give the arm somewhere soft and supported to settle, so the body can focus on healing without the distraction of discomfort.

The removable cover can be taken off and washed independently of the pillow filling, which keeps the product hygienic through regular use without any complicated care requirements. Three printed cover options are available — Wildflower Garden, Willow Print, and Aparajita Petals — each designed to feel personal and considered rather than clinical or institutional.
Lightweight and compact, Nature Nest is easy to carry between rooms, take to appointments, or pack for short stays away from home. It is designed to be wherever rest happens.
Section 03  —  Product Story

A nest is one of nature’s most intentional structures. It is not built for beauty, though it often has it. It is built for one purpose: to hold something that needs protecting, with softness, with care, and with exactly the right amount of support.

Nature Nest takes its name from that idea. The word ‘Nature’ reflects the materials at the heart of the product — plant-fiber filling, natural fabric, printed covers that draw from gardens, leaves, and petals. The word ‘Nest’ reflects its purpose: a soft, specific place for the arm to settle during rest, so the body is not working to hold itself in a comfortable position while it heals.

Recovery after breast surgery asks a great deal of the body. The chest and underarm area can be tender for weeks. The arm on the affected side often needs to be positioned carefully during rest — not too close to the body, not too far, supported but not pressed. Finding that position with just a regular bed or sofa can be frustrating. A rolled towel is too firm. A standard pillow is too large and too soft. Neither is shaped for the job.

Nature Nest is shaped for the job. Its profile fits naturally against the side of the body, under the arm, and provides a consistent, gentle lift that reduces pressure without creating new pressure points. It stays in place during rest without needing to be constantly readjusted. It is light enough to carry easily between the bed, the sofa, and appointments.

The printed covers were chosen because recovery deserves objects that feel personal and considered. The Wildflower Garden, Willow Print, and Aparajita Petals prints were each designed with the same care as the pillow itself — to bring a small, genuine moment of beauty into the days when beauty can feel far away.
Nature Nest. A soft place for your arm to rest while the rest of you heals.
Section 04  —  What Makes It Special
Shaped Specifically for Underarm Support

Nature Nest is not a repurposed standard pillow. Its shape is designed around the specific geometry of the underarm and side of the body during rest. The profile provides a natural lift for the arm without pushing it outward or creating pressure at the shoulder or wrist. This specificity of shape is what separates it from using a rolled blanket or standard cushion.
Plant-Fiber Filling

The filling is made from lightweight plant fiber, which provides a soft, compressible cushion that yields gently under the weight of the arm rather than pushing back firmly. Plant-fiber filling stays cool during extended rest, which is meaningful when the underarm area is already sensitive and prone to warmth after surgery.
Removable, Washable Cover

The printed cover can be removed completely and washed separately from the pillow filling. This is a practical necessity for a product used close to healing skin. It allows the pillow to be kept hygienic through regular washing without putting the filling through water and drying cycles that would compromise its softness and shape over time.
Three Beautiful Printed Covers

Three print options are available: Wildflower Garden, Willow Print, and Aparajita Petals. Each print was chosen to feel genuinely personal rather than generic or institutional. The covers are the part of the pillow that is visible and present in the room, and they are designed to feel like a thoughtful, comforting object rather than a medical product.
Lightweight and Portable

Nature Nest is light enough to carry from room to room, to place in a bag for appointments, or to take along for short stays away from home. Recovery does not only happen in one location, and Nature Nest is designed to go wherever rest is needed.
Gentle on Sensitive Areas

The outer cover fabric is soft against the skin and does not have seams or edges positioned to press into sensitive underarm tissue. The pillow is designed to reduce contact pressure on healing areas, not to add to it.
Suitable Beyond the Recovery Period

Nature Nest is designed for recovery but not limited to it. As an everyday rest support pillow — for reading, for watching television, for resting on a sofa — it continues to provide comfortable arm support long after the most acute phase of recovery has passed.
Section 05  —  Key Benefits
Reduces Pressure on the Underarm and Chest Area During Rest

In the days and weeks following breast surgery, the underarm area is often tender, swollen, or sensitive in ways that make finding a comfortable resting position genuinely difficult. Lying with the arm against the body creates pressure on exactly the areas that need relief. Nature Nest sits between the arm and the body during rest, providing a soft cushioned buffer that lifts the arm slightly and distributes its weight away from the most sensitive points. This is a small physical change that produces a meaningful improvement in comfort during the hours spent resting.
Helps the Arm Find a Supported, Natural Position

The arm on the affected side after breast surgery often needs to be held slightly away from the body and in a specific position to avoid pressure or discomfort. Maintaining that position during rest is tiring and difficult without support. Nature Nest provides that support passively — the arm rests on the pillow without effort, stays in a comfortable and appropriate position, and the muscles responsible for holding it there can relax. The quality of rest that follows is meaningfully better than rest spent constantly adjusting position.
Stays Cool Against Sensitive Skin

Plant-fiber filling does not trap and retain heat the way denser synthetic fillings do. During rest, the pillow stays at a temperature close to room temperature rather than warming up against the body over time. For underarm skin that may already be warm or inflamed during recovery, this is a genuine comfort benefit rather than a minor detail.
Easy to Keep Hygienic

Proximity to healing skin means hygiene matters for any product used during recovery. The removable cover is the simple solution: take it off, wash it, put the clean one on. There is no need to wash the entire pillow, no complicated drying process, and no period when the pillow cannot be used because it is still drying. The washing and replacing of the cover takes a few minutes and keeps the pillow clean through the full duration of recovery.
A Comforting Presence in the Recovery Space

The physical space of recovery — the bedroom, the sofa, the chair where rest happens — can begin to feel oppressive or institutional during extended periods at home. The printed covers on Nature Nest are one small way of making that space feel more like itself. A pillow with a wildflower print or a soft willow leaf design is not a medical device. It is a beautiful, comforting object that happens to be doing a useful physical job. That distinction is meaningful when the days are long and the space needs to feel like home.
Useful Far Beyond the First Weeks of Recovery

The underarm support that Nature Nest provides is not relevant only in the immediate post-surgical period. As recovery continues and the body heals, the pillow continues to provide comfortable arm support during long periods of rest. Many women continue using Nature Nest months after surgery for everyday reading, relaxing, and rest. The prints and quality of the product are designed for that longer lifespan rather than for short-term use only.
Section 06  —  Materials & Construction
Plant-Fiber Filling

The filling inside Nature Nest is made from lightweight natural plant fiber. Plant-fiber filling is softer and more compressible than synthetic polyester or foam alternatives, which means it yields gently under the weight of the arm rather than pushing back with firm resistance. It also breathes more effectively than synthetic materials, staying cooler during extended rest periods.

The filling is contained within the pillow inner, which is a separate layer from the removable outer cover. This two-layer construction means the filling stays clean and protected even when the cover is removed for washing, and the filling itself does not need to be washed or dried.
Printed Cover Fabric

The outer cover is made from a soft cotton-blend fabric selected for its print clarity, softness against the skin, and durability through repeated washing. The prints are applied at the fabric level rather than printed onto a finished surface, which means they do not crack, fade significantly, or peel with regular washing at the recommended temperature.

The cover is constructed with a clean opening mechanism that allows it to be removed and replaced easily without tools and without the risk of catching on or pressing into sensitive skin during the process. All seams on the cover are positioned to avoid contact with underarm skin during wear.
Pillow Shape and Profile

Nature Nest has an ergonomic profile shaped to fit naturally between the arm and the side of the body during rest. The upper surface, which the arm rests on, has a gentle contour that accommodates the natural curve of the arm without creating pressure points at the elbow or wrist. The inner face, which sits against the body, is shaped to conform to the side of the chest without pressing into the underarm tissue.
Construction Quality

The inner pillow seams are reinforced to prevent the filling from compressing into corners or shifting unevenly during use. The outer cover seams are finished to eliminate any rough edges that could contact the skin. The overall construction is designed to maintain its shape and softness through regular daily use without flattening, compressing permanently, or losing the gentle support it provides when new.
Section 07  —  Available Prints

Nature Nest is available in three printed cover options. Each print was selected to feel personal, considered, and genuinely beautiful — a deliberate choice against the plain or clinical aesthetic that most recovery products default to. The pillow itself is the same across all three prints; the print is on the removable outer cover only.
Wildflower Garden Print

A full, abundant floral print featuring blue daisies, white daisies, yellow-centred wildflowers, and soft green leaves across a pale sage-green background. The print draws from the visual language of an informal garden in full bloom — the kind of garden that grows freely rather than being formally arranged, with colour distributed generously across the fabric.

Wildflower Garden is the most colourful of the three prints. It is cheerful without being loud, detailed without being busy. It is the print for women who want something that feels warm and alive in their recovery space — a piece of a summer garden brought inside.
Willow Print

A botanical print of long, sweeping willow leaves and branches rendered in soft blue and teal watercolour tones on a pale cream-blue background. Willow Print is the most serene of the three options. The blue palette and flowing leaf shapes create a calming visual effect that works particularly well in a bedroom or quiet rest space. A simple, scattered print of small navy blue and soft pink dots on a clean white background. The dots are painterly and irregular — each one slightly different in shape and density — giving the print a hand-painted quality rather than the uniformity of a mechanical pattern. The overall effect is light, airy, and quietly joyful.

Aparajita Petals is the most versatile of the three prints. Its clean white base and simple pattern work in any room and with any surroundings. It is the print for women who prefer something understated but still personal — a delicate, considered detail rather than a statement.
Choosing Your Print

All three prints are available in the same pillow construction and at the same price. The choice is entirely personal. Many women choose based on which print feels most like them — the warmth of Wildflower Garden, the calm of Willow, or the simplicity of Aparajita Petals. Additional covers in different prints can be purchased separately if you would like to change the look of the pillow over time.
Section 08  —  What’s Included
1 x Nature Nest Underarm Rest Pillow

The inner pillow filled with plant fiber, shaped to the ergonomic underarm support profile. The filling is pre-shaped and ready to use immediately on arrival. The pillow arrives with the cover already fitted.

The selected printed cover in your chosen print — Wildflower Garden, Willow Print, or Aparajita Petals. The cover is fitted to the pillow on arrival and can be removed and washed as needed. Additional replacement covers in any of the three prints are available to purchase separately.
Care Instructions Card

A printed care card with washing instructions for the cover, care guidance for the pillow filling, storage recommendations, and practical tips for getting the most comfortable and longest-lasting use from your Nature Nest.
Section 09  —  How To Use
Positioning Nature Nest for Underarm Support
Sit or lie in your preferred resting position — in bed, on a sofa, or in a chair.
Place Nature Nest against the side of your body on the side where support is needed, with the upper surface of the pillow positioned where your arm will naturally rest.
Allow your arm to settle onto the pillow. The pillow should lift the arm slightly away from the body without pushing it outward at the shoulder.
Adjust the position of the pillow slightly until the arm feels comfortably supported with no pressure on the underarm or chest area.
Rest. The pillow is designed to stay in position during normal rest without needing frequent readjustment.
For Reading or Seated Rest

When resting in a seated position — reading, watching television, or sitting upright — place Nature Nest against the armrest of the chair or sofa, between the armrest and your body. This brings the support surface to a height that allows the arm to rest naturally without the shoulder lifting or the elbow hanging.
For Overnight or Extended Rest

For longer rest periods, position the pillow at the side of the body on the bed. It does not need to be held in place — the weight of the arm resting on it provides enough stability for extended use. Some women position it slightly forward of the hip to provide support at the mid-arm, which reduces shoulder tension during sleep.
Adjusting the Fit Over Time

As your comfort needs change through recovery — as swelling reduces, sensitivity decreases, and the arm regains more natural movement — you may find the most comfortable position for Nature Nest also changes. The pillow does not have a fixed or required position. Adjust freely based on where support feels most useful at any point in your recovery.
Section 10  —  Care Instructions
Washing the Cover
The cover should be washed when visibly soiled or at regular intervals during use. Washing frequency depends on how often the pillow is used and how close it is to healing skin.
Remove the cover from the pillow filling by opening the closure and sliding the cover off.
Machine wash on a gentle cycle at 30 degrees Celsius using a mild detergent, or hand wash in cool water with a small amount of mild detergent.
Rinse thoroughly.
Do not tumble dry. Lay flat or hang to dry in a well-ventilated area away from direct sunlight.
Once completely dry, slide the cover back onto the pillow filling and close the opening securely.
Caring for the Pillow Filling

The plant-fiber filling inside the pillow should not be machine washed, soaked, or submerged in water. The filling is contained in a separate inner layer; as long as the outer cover is washed regularly, the filling should remain clean through normal use.
If the filling requires spot cleaning, use a barely damp clean cloth to gently address the affected area, then allow to air dry completely in a well-ventilated space before covering and using again.
Storage

Store Nature Nest in a clean, dry location when not in use. The pillow can be stored on the bed, on a chair, or in a breathable bag. Do not compress the pillow under heavy items for extended periods, as this may reduce the filling’s ability to return to its natural soft shape.
What Not to Do
Do not machine wash or soak the pillow filling
Do not tumble dry the cover
Do not bleach the cover
Do not iron the printed cover directly
Do not store in an airtight bag or container
Do not compress under heavy items for extended periods
Lifespan and Replacement

With regular cover washing and proper care, Nature Nest is designed to maintain its shape and comfort through the full duration of recovery and beyond. The cover can be replaced if it wears out before the pillow filling does. Replacement covers in all three prints are available from Nuvanaah.
Section 11  —  Perfect For
The Early Weeks of Post-Surgical Recovery

The first few weeks after breast surgery are when the underarm and chest area are at their most sensitive. This is when finding a comfortable resting position takes the most effort and when discomfort during rest is most acute. Nature Nest is designed for exactly this period. It does the work of positioning the arm correctly so the body does not have to.
Rest at Home During Recovery

Whether resting in bed, on the sofa, or in a chair, Nature Nest provides consistent underarm support in any resting position. It is light enough to move between rooms easily, so it is always where rest is happening rather than left in one location.
Recovery Appointments and Day Visits

For time spent sitting in waiting rooms, travel to and from appointments, or day stays at a hospital or clinic, Nature Nest provides the same underarm support it offers at home. Its compact size allows it to be carried in a bag or held comfortably during transit.
Overnight Hospital Stays

Hospital beds and chairs are not designed with post-breast-surgery comfort as a specific requirement. Bringing Nature Nest to an overnight stay or short admission means comfortable underarm support in an environment that would not otherwise provide it.
Everyday Rest After Recovery

Recovery eventually ends, but the comfort of good arm support during rest does not. Many women continue using Nature Nest as an everyday rest pillow long after the acute recovery phase has passed. The quality of the construction and the beauty of the prints are designed for this longer lifespan.
As a Thoughtful Gift

Nature Nest is a considered, useful, and genuinely beautiful gift for a woman going through recovery. Unlike flowers that fade or food that is consumed, it is something useful that will be part of daily life during a period when thoughtful gifts matter most. The printed covers make it a personal, carefully chosen object rather than a generic recovery product.
Section 12  —  A Gentle Note

Recovery takes time. More time, often, than people expect. The early weeks can be physically uncomfortable, and the longer weeks that follow can be emotionally draining in ways that are harder to describe. Finding comfort during this period — physical comfort, the small, daily kind — matters more than it might seem.

Nature Nest cannot shorten recovery or remove discomfort entirely. What it can do is make the hours spent resting more comfortable. It can give your arm somewhere soft and supported to settle. It can mean one fewer thing to think about and adjust and manage during the days when everything requires more effort than usual.
Small comforts are not small things during recovery. They are part of what makes it possible to rest well, which is part of what makes healing possible.
Rest when you can. Let Nature Nest be one less thing to manage.
Section 13  —  Frequently Asked Questions
What is Nature Nest?

Nature Nest is a soft underarm rest pillow designed to provide gentle support for the arm and underarm area during post-surgical recovery and everyday rest. It is filled with plant fiber and has a removable, washable printed cover.
What is it designed to do?

Nature Nest is designed to sit between the arm and the side of the body during rest, providing a soft cushioned surface that lifts the arm slightly and reduces pressure on the underarm and chest area. It helps the arm find a comfortable, supported resting position without effort.
Who is it designed for?

Nature Nest is designed for women recovering from breast surgery, including mastectomy and lumpectomy, who need underarm support during rest. It is also useful for anyone who finds everyday arm support during rest beneficial.
Is it a medical device?
No. Nature Nest is a comfort product, not a medical device. It is not intended to replace any element of post-surgical medical care. It is designed to make resting more comfortable during recovery.
What is the pillow filled with?

The filling is lightweight natural plant fiber, which provides a soft, compressible surface that yields gently under the arm, stays cool during rest, and does not flatten permanently with regular use.
What prints are available?

What does each print look like?

Wildflower Garden features colourful wildflowers on a pale sage-green background. Willow Print features soft blue watercolour willow leaves on a pale cream-blue background. Aparajita Petals features scattered navy and pink dots on a white background.
Can I buy additional covers in different prints?
Yes. Replacement covers in all three prints are available to purchase separately from Nuvanaah, allowing you to change the look of the pillow or replace a cover that has worn out.
Is the cover removable?
Yes. The cover can be removed from the pillow filling and washed independently. This is the recommended care method.
How do I wash the cover?
Machine wash on a gentle cycle at 30 degrees Celsius, or hand wash in cool water with mild detergent. Do not tumble dry. Lay flat or hang to dry away from direct sunlight.
Can I wash the pillow filling?
No. The plant-fiber filling should not be washed or submerged in water. Keep the cover washed regularly to maintain hygiene without needing to wash the filling.
Is the pillow lightweight?
Yes. Nature Nest is designed to be light enough to carry between rooms, take to appointments, and pack for short stays away from home.
Can I take it to a hospital appointment?
Yes. Its compact, portable design makes it practical for taking to appointments, waiting rooms, and short hospital stays.
Can I use it on both sides of the body?
Yes. Nature Nest can be positioned under either arm and used on either side of the body depending on where support is needed.
Can I use it while sleeping?
Yes. Nature Nest can be used during overnight rest. Position it at the side of the body on the bed to provide underarm support during sleep.
How long will I need to use it?

This depends entirely on your individual recovery. Some women use Nature Nest most intensively in the first weeks after surgery. Others continue using it throughout a longer recovery period. Many women continue using it as an everyday rest pillow after recovery is complete.
Is it good as a gift for someone recovering from surgery?

Yes. Nature Nest is a practical, comforting, and beautiful gift that will be genuinely useful during recovery. The printed cover options make it a personal and considered choice rather than a generic item.

Nature Nest is priced at ₹ 1,500. The price is the same across all three print options.
How do I store it when not in use?
Store in a clean, dry location. Do not compress under heavy objects for extended periods. The pillow can be stored openly on a bed, chair, or in a breathable bag.
What makes Nature Nest different from using a regular pillow?

Nature Nest is shaped specifically for underarm support, with a profile designed to fit against the side of the body and provide a lift for the arm that a standard pillow cannot replicate. A regular pillow is too large, too soft, and not shaped for this specific purpose. Nature Nest is designed for exactly this job.

After each wear, gently smooth the real human hair with a soft brush or your fingers to keep it looking its best. Store the system in its included storage solution immediately after.

Willow Wrap is a soft head scarf collection made from bamboo plant-fiber fabric, designed to provide comfortable, breathable coverage for women experiencing hair loss and for anyone who wants an everyday head covering that feels as good as it looks.

The fabric is the heart of this product. Bamboo plant fiber is naturally soft — noticeably softer than cotton or synthetic alternatives — and it has a breathability that keeps the scalp comfortable during extended wear. For skin that may be sensitive following treatment, this combination of softness and breathability is particularly meaningful. The scarf does not scratch, does not trap heat, and does not feel like a compromise between coverage and comfort.

Willow Wrap is available in three printed designs: Wildflower Garden, Willow Print, and Aparajita Petals. Each print is produced on the same quality of bamboo fabric and each is designed to feel personal and considered. These are not generic head coverings. They are scarves with distinct visual identities, chosen to give women a genuine sense of aesthetic choice during a period when many choices feel out of their control.

The scarf can be tied, draped, and styled in multiple ways, which means it adapts to different occasions, different moods, and different amounts of coverage depending on what the day requires. It is lightweight enough to fold into a bag and take anywhere. It is gentle enough to wear directly against a bare scalp. It is beautiful enough to want to wear even after hair has returned.
